bronze_boundaries: Keep national and payer aggregates independent; do not claim cross-country comparability.
Keep the public Japanese aggregate Tableau surface separate from credentialed microdata and do not claim an official bulk file.
Treat CIHI NHEX drug expenditure as macro expenditure, not medicine-level utilisation or formulary evidence.
Treat HSE PCRS claims and payments as scheme-bounded reporting, not total Irish medicine use.
Do not manufacture zero utilisation or coverage from absent cells or absent source files.
